title: Introduction To Computer Design
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those given by c(F*(q0, x)) = 1 that is, the sequences x such that, when started in state q0, after reading x, the machine is in a state q such that c(q) = 1."
The sequences it accepts are those given by c(F*(q0, x)) = 1 that is, the sequences x such that, when started in state q0, after reading x, the machine is in a state q such that c(q) = 1.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a universally accepted code that allows 128 characters and symbols to be represented."
The ASCII code is a universally accepted code that allows 128 characters and symbols to be represented.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to uniquely select or deselect the appropriate devices."
A decoder is used to uniquely select or deselect the appropriate devices.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are described using a 4-bit shift register."
The different shift operations are described using a 4-bit shift register.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in assembly language, just as in HLLs, to mark lines as the targets of GOTOs (jumps)."
Labels are used in assembly language, just as in HLLs, to mark lines as the targets of GOTOs (jumps).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an instruction name (e.g., mov, add, etc.)."
A mnemonic is an instruction name (e.g., mov, add, etc.).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an example of a transducer."
The edge detector is an example of a transducer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to represent decimal digits in binary."
Binary Coded Decimal (BCD) code is used to represent decimal digits in binary.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to these addressing modes as based addressing and indexed addressing."
Note that Intel still refers to these addressing modes as based addressing and indexed addressing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an m-to-n line where m≤2n."
A standard decoder is an m-to-n line where m≤2n.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the basic, essential software without which a computer would not be able to function."
The operating system is the basic, essential software without which a computer would not be able to function.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to maintain stable data at the input of the multiplexer."
Latches are used to maintain stable data at the input of the multiplexer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to represent a decimal number."
The dot is used to represent a decimal number.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a quicker method to determine decimal equivalents of binary numbers without resorting to writing an expression."
The sum-of-non-zero terms method is a quicker method to determine decimal equivalents of binary numbers without resorting to writing an expression.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the pathways that connect the microprocessor to memory and other components."
Bus interfaces are the pathways that connect the microprocessor to memory and other components.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the cathodes of all of the LEDs are common and connected to a single pin."
Common cathode means that the cathodes of all of the LEDs are common and connected to a single pin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a microprocessor chip-that is, a single piece of silicon containing millions of tiny, microscopically wired electrical components."
The CPU is a microprocessor chip-that is, a single piece of silicon containing millions of tiny, microscopically wired electrical components.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means that the anode (positive) side of all of the LEDs are electrically connected at one pin, and each LED cathode has its own pin."
Common anode means that the anode (positive) side of all of the LEDs are electrically connected at one pin, and each LED cathode has its own pin.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the interval of time when the input is applied and the output changes."
The propagation delay time is the interval of time when the input is applied and the output changes.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a specialised logic unit optimised to perform non-integer calculations much faster than the general-purpose logic unit can perform them."
The floating-point unit (FPU) is a specialised logic unit optimised to perform non-integer calculations much faster than the general-purpose logic unit can perform them.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a 4-bit binary code; the first 10 combinations represent the decimal digits 0 to 9."
BCD code is a 4-bit binary code; the first 10 combinations represent the decimal digits 0 to 9.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to overcome this difficulty."
Flip-flops are used to overcome this difficulty.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of wires that carry various sorts of information between the devices connected to those wires."
A bus is a set of wires that carry various sorts of information between the devices connected to those wires.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of two parts the Master and the Slave."
The Master-Slave flip-flop is composed of two parts the Master and the Slave.
fib: ______ is a digital switch that has several inputs and a single output.
Multiplexer
Multiplexer is a digital switch that has several inputs and a single output.
______ is the first step towards mastering assembly language.
Mastery of the addressing modes
Mastery of the addressing modes is the first step towards mastering assembly language.
______ refers to [bx] and [bp] as base addressing modes and bx and bp as base registers (in fact, bp stands for base pointer).
Intel
Intel refers to [bx] and [bp] as base addressing modes and bx and bp as base registers (in fact, bp stands for base pointer).
______ is a signal sent by another device to the CPU.
interrupt
An interrupt is a signal sent by another device to the CPU.
______ is a complex system consisting of many different components.
computer
A computer is a complex system consisting of many different components.
______ are a major cause of errors in assembly language subroutines.
Stack problems
Stack problems are a major cause of errors in assembly language subroutines.
______ is an Asynchronous SRAM, the operation of which does not depend upon the clock signal.
Static memory described
The Static memory described is an Asynchronous SRAM, the operation of which does not depend upon the clock signal.
______ is a positional number system as the position of a digit represents its true magnitude.
decimal number system
The decimal number system is a positional number system as the position of a digit represents its true magnitude.
______ is an m-to-n- line encoder, where m≤2n.
standard binary encoder
A standard binary encoder is an m-to-n- line encoder, where m≤2n.
______ are considered deterministic if all transitions to next states are unique to a given state and its inputs.
Finite State Machines
Finite State Machines are considered deterministic if all transitions to next states are unique to a given state and its inputs.
______ is the discharging of the capacitor over a period of time.
drawback of DRAM
The drawback of DRAM is the discharging of the capacitor over a period of time.
______ is a temporary storage device that has two stable states.
latch
A latch is a temporary storage device that has two stable states.
______ is a set of flip-flops connected in parallel to store multi-bit binary information.
register
A register is a set of flip-flops connected in parallel to store multi-bit binary information.
______ is a little more difficult because you must load cs:ip in a single operation.
Simulating a far return
Simulating a far return is a little more difficult because you must load cs:ip in a single operation.
______ is the final offset produced by an addressing mode computation.
effective address
The effective address is the final offset produced by an addressing mode computation.
______ is known as a Dynamic RAM (DRAM).
capacitor based memory
The capacitor based memory is known as a Dynamic RAM (DRAM).
______ is a base-2 number system having only two numbers 0 and 1.
Binary as the name indicates
Binary as the name indicates is a base-2 number system having only two numbers 0 and 1.
______ are used to implement a latch.
Four gates
Four gates are used to implement a latch.
______ is the overall representation of the edge detector.
function f
The function f is the overall representation of the edge detector.
______ is used as the demultiplexer data input.
decoder enable input
The decoder enable input is used as the demultiplexer data input.
______ are used to route the contents of any two registers to the ALU inputs.
multiplexers
The multiplexers are used to route the contents of any two registers to the ALU inputs.
______ are the basic tool for creating loops and other conditionally executable statements like the ―if … then‖ statement.
conditional jump instructions
The conditional jump instructions are the basic tool for creating loops and other conditionally executable statements like the ―if … then‖ statement.
______ is a base 16 number system and therefore has 16 digits and is used primarily to represent binary strings in a compact manner.
hexadecimal number system
The hexadecimal number system is a base 16 number system and therefore has 16 digits and is used primarily to represent binary strings in a compact manner.
